description: Old Man catch tutorial event in Viridian City.

tutorial_steps.text: Ive had my coffee now and Im feeling great! Sure, Ill show you how to catch a Pokemon!
The Old Man walks to the tall grass on Route 1.
First, you weaken the Pokemon with attacks...
Then throw a Poke Ball when its weak!
All right! The Pokemon was caught!
Thats how you do it! Once you have your own Pokemon, you can catch wild Pokemon too!
The Old Man returns to Viridian City.
